mk-world-povardarie.basis: Three wine regions under the Law on Wine; vinogorje lists by municipality were not available, so outlines are approximate.
mk-world-povardarie.outline: Built from the administrative units that contain the area. The legal boundary follows other lines (roads, rivers, farms or altitude), so the real area is smaller.
